# Sinawi

> Sinawi is a macOS app (Tauri + React + a local Node/Express server on 127.0.0.1:3001) that runs the Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build CLIs as one team: a lead plans and delegates to workers, project leads own a project long-term, and schedules, workspaces (spaces: each with its own chats, leads, policy and, optionally, its own CLI logins), skills and merge policies organize the work. Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other AIs can be the orchestrator through an MCP server: open chats under a lead, send work to a chat, pick the model, wait for and read results, while the user watches those chats live. Connect from **Settings → Connect an AI**, which gives a per-client command (`claude mcp add`, `codex mcp add`, `grok mcp add`) running the bridge bundled in the app (`/Applications/Sinawi.app/Contents/Resources/sinawi-mcp.mjs`) or writes the Claude Desktop / Cursor config; `npx -y @rakmlabs/sinawi mcp` works only after the npm package is published; its risky tools wait for the user's approval in the app.

Start with the AI reference: it lists every MCP tool (generated from `server/app-tools.ts`), how to connect and authenticate, the HTTP API and the known limits.

## Docs for AI agents

- [For AI agents](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/docs/ai/for-ai.md): concepts, MCP connection, token, full tool list with approval flags, HTTP API, limits
- [AI 에이전트용 (Korean)](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/docs/ai/for-ai.ko.md): the same in Korean, with the registry's own tool descriptions
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/AGENTS.md): for coding agents contributing to this repo — layout, commands, isolated dev setup, commit style, rules

## Product docs

- [README](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/README.md): what Sinawi does, install, MCP setup, copy-paste prompts for AI assistants, development, safety
- [sinawi package README](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/packages/sinawi/README.md): the bridge, per-client connect commands, environment variables, errors; `npx @rakmlabs/sinawi` (installer) and `npx @rakmlabs/sinawi mcp` once the package is published
- [Project leads and MCP](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): leads, merge policy, `sinawi_lead` tools, schedules, connecting Claude Code / Codex / Grok Build / Claude Desktop / Cursor, the orchestrator loop (`list_leads` → `create_session` → `wait_for_session` → `send_message`)
- [MCP tool coverage](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/docs/mcp-coverage.md): every tool with the HTTP route it drives, approvals, excluded routes (Korean)

## Code

- [server/app-tools.ts](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/server/app-tools.ts): the tool registry (`APP_TOOLS`, `ROUTE_EXCLUSIONS`) both MCP surfaces read
- [packages/sinawi](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/tree/main/packages/sinawi): the npm package `@rakmlabs/sinawi`; `lib/mcp.mjs` is the one stdio MCP bridge (also bundled into the app and run by `scripts/sinawi-mcp.mjs`), `lib/install.mjs` the app installer
- [server/mcp-clients.ts](https://github.com/Rakmlabs/sinawi/blob/main/server/mcp-clients.ts): the Connect page's "Connect to Claude Desktop / Cursor" (merges `mcpServers.sinawi`, keeps a `.bak`)
